parameters.query: ={{ (() => { const body = $('Profile Auth Webhook').item.json.body || {}; const q = value => "'" + String(value || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "'"; const action = body.action; if (action === 'list') return 'SELECT id, username, email, created_at FROM profiles ORDER BY LOWER(username)'; if (action === 'create') return `INSERT INTO profiles (username, email, password_hash) VALUES (${q(body.username)}, ${q(body.email)}, crypt(${q(body.password)}, gen_salt('bf', 12))) RETURNING id, username, email, created_at`; if (action === 'login') return `SELECT id, username, email, created_at FROM profiles WHERE username = ${q(body.username)} AND password_hash = crypt(${q(body.password)}, password_hash)`; throw new Error('Unsupported profile action'); })() }}
